source.content: List<RoundingMode> rounding = RoundingMode.values(); System.assertEquals(8, rounding.size()); System.assertEquals(RoundingMode.UP, rounding.get(0)); System.assertEquals(RoundingMode.DOWN, rounding.get(1)); System.assertEquals(RoundingMode.CEILING, rounding.get(2)); System.assertEquals(RoundingMode.FLOOR, rounding.get(3)); System.assertEquals(RoundingMode.HALF_UP, rounding.get(4)); System.assertEquals(RoundingMode.HALF_DOWN, rounding.get(5)); System.assertEquals(RoundingMode.HALF_EVEN, rounding.get(6)); System.assertEquals(RoundingMode.UNNECESSARY, rounding.get(7)); System.assertEquals(RoundingMode.UNNECESSARY, RoundingMode.valueOf('UNNECESSARY')); System.assert(RoundingMode.CEILING.equals(rounding.get(2))); System.assertEquals(RoundingMode.CEILING.hashCode(), rounding.get(2).hashCode()); System.assertEquals(2, RoundingMode.CEILING.ordinal()); List<AccessType> access = AccessType.values(); System.assertEquals(4, access.size()); System.assertEquals(AccessType.CREATABLE, access.get(0)); System.assertEquals(AccessType.READABLE, access.get(1)); System.assertEquals(AccessType.UPDATABLE, access.get(2)); System.assertEquals(AccessType.UPSERTABLE, access.get(3)); System.assertEquals(AccessType.UPDATABLE, AccessType.valueOf('UPDATABLE')); System.assert(AccessType.UPDATABLE.equals(access.get(2))); System.assertEquals(AccessType.UPDATABLE.hashCode(), access.get(2).hashCode()); System.assertEquals(2, AccessType.UPDATABLE.ordinal()); List<Quiddity> quiddities = Quiddity.values(); System.assertEquals(32, quiddities.size()); System.assertEquals(Quiddity.VF, quiddities.get(10)); System.assertEquals(Quiddity.AURA, quiddities.get(13)); System.assertEquals(Quiddity.QUICK_ACTION, quiddities.get(14)); System.assertEquals(Quiddity.QUICK_ACTION, Quiddity.valueOf('QUICK_ACTION')); System.assert(Quiddity.AURA.equals(quiddities.get(13))); System.assertEquals(Quiddity.AURA.hashCode(), quiddities.get(13).hashCode()); System.assertEquals(13, Quiddity.AURA.ordinal()); List<Schema.FieldDescribeOptions> fieldOptions = Schema.FieldDescribeOptions.values(); System.assertEquals(2, fieldOptions.size()); System.assertEquals(Schema.FieldDescribeOptions.DEFAULT, fieldOptions.get(0)); System.assertEquals(Schema.FieldDescribeOptions.FULL_DESCRIBE, fieldOptions.get(1)); System.assertEquals(Schema.FieldDescribeOptions.FULL_DESCRIBE, Schema.FieldDescribeOptions.valueOf('FULL_DESCRIBE')); System.assert(Schema.FieldDescribeOptions.FULL_DESCRIBE.equals(fieldOptions.get(1))); System.assertEquals(Schema.FieldDescribeOptions.FULL_DESCRIBE.hashCode(), fieldOptions.get(1).hashCode()); System.assertEquals(1, Schema.FieldDescribeOptions.FULL_DESCRIBE.ordinal()); List<Schema.SObjectDescribeOptions> objectOptions = Schema.SObjectDescribeOptions.values(); System.assertEquals(3, objectOptions.size()); System.assertEquals(Schema.SObjectDescribeOptions.DEFAULT, objectOptions.get(0)); System.assertEquals(Schema.SObjectDescribeOptions.FULL, objectOptions.get(1)); System.assertEquals(Schema.SObjectDescribeOptions.DEFERRED, objectOptions.get(2)); System.assertEquals(Schema.SObjectDescribeOptions.FULL, Schema.SObjectDescribeOptions.valueOf('FULL')); System.assert(Schema.SObjectDescribeOptions.FULL.equals(objectOptions.get(1))); System.assertEquals(Schema.SObjectDescribeOptions.FULL.hashCode(), objectOptions.get(1).hashCode()); System.assertEquals(1, Schema.SObjectDescribeOptions.FULL.ordinal());
